purpose: Install only the restricted ordinary sandbox registration entry on the original platform Neon PostgreSQL 18 database

target.neonInstaller: Exact existing authenticated database owner bound through the original preflight's pinned W7k receipt, with current_user = session_user, CREATEROLE and no superuser

expectedCreatorMembership.temporaryGrantor: authenticated installer (CURRENT_USER = SESSION_USER when granting and revoking)

functionAssembly.extractOnly: The unique CREATE FUNCTION sandbox_registration.register_account(... through its closing $register$; inclusive, not the old surrounding DDL or COMMIT
functionAssembly.deriveOnlyAfterSeparateApproval: Using the same unchanged private test-email file, apply normalizeAuthEmail and SHA-256 of UTF-8. Set only the existing digest parameter of sandboxRegistrationDdl; never output or commit the address, digest or assembled production function body.
functionAssembly.inputBindingLimit: The previous read-only receipt intentionally contains no identity hash. Require operator confirmation that the exact email file is unchanged since that attempt and reject a newer modification time; this is not retrospective cryptographic proof.

transactionRecipe.identityBeforeDdl: One catalog SELECT: match pinned authenticated installer, database and owner OIDs, Web OID and PostgreSQL 18. Do not replay the prior schema/ACL/identity lookup sweep.
asInstaller: CREATE ROLE techlong_sandbox_registration_definer NOLOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEROLE NOCREATEDB NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS
GRANT techlong_sandbox_registration_definer TO SESSION_USER WITH ADMIN FALSE, INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO techlong_sandbox_registration_definer
GRANT INSERT (id, email, name, status, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at) ON public.users TO techlong_sandbox_registration_definer
GRANT INSERT (id, name, owner_id, status, contact_name, contact_email, subscription_status, app_instance_status, created_at, updated_at) ON public.workspaces TO techlong_sandbox_registration_definer
GRANT INSERT (id, workspace_id, user_id, role, joined_at) ON public.workspace_members TO techlong_sandbox_registration_definer
GRANT INSERT (user_id, password_hash, password_salt, password_iterations, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at) ON public.user_credentials TO techlong_sandbox_registration_definer
beforeFunction: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA sandbox_registration FROM PUBLIC
transactionRecipe.createFunction: Exactly the one privately rendered function in functionAssembly
afterFunction: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION sandbox_registration.register_account(text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA sandbox_registration TO techlong_platform_web_acceptance_v1
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION sandbox_registration.register_account(text, text, text, text) TO techlong_platform_web_acceptance_v1
closeTemporaryAccess: REVOKE techlong_sandbox_registration_definer FROM SESSION_USER GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER RESTRICT
transactionRecipe.verifyThenEnd: One catalog SELECT for expected delta in the same transaction. Explicit COMMIT only on exact match and within deadline, otherwise ROLLBACK before any commit submission. A lost commit response is unknown, not a retry or a cleanup authorization.

verifyExpectedDeltaBeforeCommitAndIndepe: Exactly one new NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT, non-elevated definer. It owns exactly the new schema and registration function in scope; no business table ownership changes. Function is SECURITY DEFINER with pg_catalog, pg_temp and the exact rendered routine (body digest compared in memory, never retained).

The only membership touching the definer is the bootstrap-to-installer ADMIN-only row with SET and INHERIT false. No installer-granted row, no indirect effective SET/USAGE for installer, and no Web membership, effective SET or inheritance path.

The definer has public schema USAGE and only the 29 listed column INSERT grants, no grant options, no table-wide INSERT, no business SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. New-schema/function ACLs contain only built-in ownership and the exact two Web permissions; PUBLIC has neither.

The Web-role effective table/column ACL on the four registration tables, plus existing auth_sessions ACL, still matches the original profile. No added Web DML, schema CREATE, membership or WITH GRANT OPTION. No changed constraints or roles outside the approved delta.
stopAndRisk: Do not begin if any pin/target/input changed, facts expired or time is insufficient. No replacement role, admin escalation, existing-object reuse, CASCADE or automatic retry/cleanup. The creator retains real future regrant capability, even though immediate SET/INHERIT is absent. Owner configuration and the one address enter memory; provider logs or readable routine metadata may disclose the email digest, which is guessable and is not email verification. Catalog checks do not remove concurrency/managed service/unknown-commit risk. A verified install is not a platform deployment or permission to retry registration.
